;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[North Korean missile tests]]
**The [[South Korea]]n [[Republic of Korea Armed Forces|military]] claims that [[North Korea]]n [[Korean People's Army|military]] has launched an "unidentified projectile" into the sea, marking the second time North Korea has conducted a weapons test in a single week. *[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**For the first time the [[United States]] seizes a [[North Korea|North Korean]] merchant ship loaded with coal in the [[East China Sea]] sailing toward Indonesia. The ship is suspected of violating sanctions. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/us-seizes-large-north-korean-ship-transport-coal-62936387 (ABC News)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/05/09/politics/us-north-korean-cargo-ship-sanctions/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/u-s-seeks-seize-north-korean-ship-suspected-violating-u-n1003811 (NBC News)]
*[[International military intervention against ISIL]]
**A blast hits [[Baghdad]]'s northeastern [[Sadr City]] district. [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility. No verified report on casualties is presently available. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-blast/blast-rocks-baghdad-marketplace-differing-accounts-on-casualties-idUSKCN1SF2AK?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Reserve Bank of Australia]] confirms it issued approximately 46 million  new [[Australian fifty-dollar note|Australian $50 note]]s in late 2018  with a typo in the background [[fine print]]: "responsibility" is misspelled as "responsibilty", the third "i" is missing. The mistake appears three times on the note and is extremely small requiring magnification to see. Part of the rollout of Australia's redesigned currency, the  A$50 notes feature the first female member of an Australian parliament, social reformer [[Edith Cowan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-48210733 (BBC News)] [https://www.theage.com.au/business/the-economy/oops-typo-for-the-ages-printed-on-46-million-new-50-notes-20190509-p51ljw.html (''The Age'')]

;Disasters and accidents

*[[European migrant crisis]]
**The [[United Nations]] states that at least 65 people are dead after a boat sinks off the coast of [[Tunisia]] while carrying migrants from [[Libya]] to [[Europe]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-05-11/dozens-of-migrants-drown-off-tunisia-coast-after-leaving-libya/11103846 (Reuters/ABC News Australia)]

;Law and crime
*Argentine congressman {{ill|Héctor Enrique Olivares|es}} of the [[Radical Civic Union|UCR]] party is shot by two assailants and is in critical condition. One of his advisers dies as a result of the gunshots. [https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/policiales/2019/05/09/olivares-fue-baleado-desde-un-auto-gris-y-no-le-robaron-nada-revelan-las-camaras-de-seguridad/ (Infobae)] [http://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/gunmen-shoot-hector-olivares-outside-congress-building-kills-another-man.phtml (''Buenos Aires Times'')]
*[[Operation Car Wash]]
** [[President of Brazil|Former Brazilian President]] [[Michel Temer]] surrenders to the federal police in response to Wednesday's arrest warrant regarding an investigation into an  alleged corruption scheme involving an [[Eletrobras]] nuclear power plant. Temer's lawyer's appeal will be heard on Tuesday. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-corruption-temer/former-brazil-president-temer-surrenders-following-new-arrest-warrant-idUSKCN1SF298?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.france24.com/en/20190509-brazil-court-orders-ex-president-temer-back-jail-corruption (France 24)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Bolivarian Intelligence Service|SEBIN]] agents detain [[Juan Guaidó]]'s deputy [[Edgar Zambrano]], the Vice President of the opposition-held [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|National Assembly]], and are reported to have taken him to [[El Helicoide]] prison. He is the most high profile opposition politician arrested since the presidential crisis began in January. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-48210625 (BBC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/vice-president-of-venezuelan-congress-detained/a-48667988 (Deutsche Welle)]
**Colleague Richard Blanco of the Brave Peoples’ Alliance party seeks [[Right of asylum|refuge]] in [[Argentina]]'s embassy in [[Caracas]],  Venezuela, following Zambrano's arrest. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuela-lawmaker-seeks-refuge-in-argentine-embassy-after-colleagues-arrest-idUSKCN1SF1YK (Reuters)]
*[[Montenegrin coup plot]]
**Russian officials are sentenced for a 2016 coup attempt in [[Montenegro]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/09/montenegro-convicts-pro-russia-politicians-of-coup-plot (''The Guardian'')]
